avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces neratinib plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort; allow 2-week washout before starting neratinib

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein inducer may decrease neratinib exposure
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative if cognitive support needed

avoid_supplements.name: Milk Thistle (Silymarin)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer and P-glycoprotein substrate may reduce neratinib bioavailability

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces neratinib systemic exposure

caution_supplements.name: Curcumin/Turmeric
caution_supplements.mechanism: Moderate CYP3A4 inhibition may increase neratinib levels; potential GI irritation additive effect
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects; dose separation not required but counsel on increased diarrhea risk

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor may slightly increase neratinib exposure
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for toxicity signs (diarrhea, rash); consider avoiding high doses

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor significantly increases neratinib bioavailability and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit, grapefruit juice, and related citrus (pomelo) during therapy

avoid_foods.name: Seville oranges and pomelos
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition similar to grapefruit increases neratinib plasma concentrations
avoid_foods.action: Avoid consumption; educate on hidden sources in marmalades and specialty beverages

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase neratinib absorption; take consistently with or without food
caution_foods.action: Advise consistent feeding state with each dose; fat content does not require dose adjustment

caution_foods.name: Spicy foods and high-fiber foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May exacerbate diarrhea (common adverse effect); fiber may affect GI transit
caution_foods.action: Counsel on moderation; provide dietary guidance for managing neratinib-induced diarrhea

monitoring_notes: Neratinib requires strict CYP3A4 inhibitor avoidance due to narrow therapeutic window and diarrhea-related dose-limiting toxicity. Counsel patients on complete grapefruit avoidance and review all herbal supplements for enzyme induction before initiating therapy; monitor for GI side effects and hepatic function periodically.
